name: HYDRA-UMC-MQTT-BROKER
notes: Real MQTT broker over real TCP. Optional MQTT CONNECT username/password authentication (MQTT_AUTH_JSON) gives the opt-in per-client-ID-prefix topic ACL (MQTT_ACL_JSON) a verified session identity; ACL scope checks prevent wildcard SUBSCRIBE escalation. An optional MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES cap is enforced on every PUBLISH. An optional retainedTtlMs/MQTT_RETAINED_TTL_MS actively expires a retained message older than the limit instead of retaining it forever. All controls are verified with real Aedes and MQTT clients, not only unit math. Evidence is simulator: the automated test suite runs in CI on the host, and a simulation bench runs the broker with a simulated fleet that goes silent, takes over identities, is away and returns, and survives a broker restart; nothing here has run on real hardware.
